thesis: The episode discusses the philosophy that long-term investment outperformance requires short-term pain and emphasizes that the contest is whether an investor can stick around long enough to harvest returns rather than the theoretical purity of factor exposure. It introduces Aptus Capital's fortified value index strategy, which employs out-of-the-money put options to protect against sudden short-term declines that might otherwise invite client misbehavior, positioning it as a more achievable alternative to classic Graham and Dodd value investing.
